• Origin: South America
  • Growth rate: Medium
  • Height: 0 - 30+ cm (average height after two months in the tank)
  • Light demand: Medium
  • CO2: Medium (6-14 mg/L)

Bacopa salzmannii 'Purple' thrives in medium to high lighting, which intensifies its purple hues. This hardy plant is relatively low maintenance and suited to aquarists of all levels. For best results, provide a nutrient-rich substrate, regular fertilization, and consider adding CO2 to maximize growth and color vibrancy. Its moderate growth rate allows for easy shaping, and simple stem cuttings make propagation straightforward.

Bacopa salzmannii 'Purple' adds an exotic touch with its vibrant purple and green tones and is a favorite for creating striking color contrasts in the aquarium. It is native to South American wetlands and is an excellent midground or background choice.

  • Unique purple coloration: adds a bold, exotic color to aquascapes.
  • Versatile planting options: midground or background placement, creating depth and contrast.
  • Easy propagation: propagate by stem cuttings.
  • Low to moderate maintenance: suitable for hobbyists of all levels.
